pca.note: Axes are clipped to the 1st–99th percentile for readability. Outlier customers outside this range are not hidden from the count; they are outside the plotted view.

warnings: The six clusters are highly imbalanced: Cluster 0 contains 94.74% of customers.
Clusters 1, 2, 4 and 5 contain 1–12 customers and should be treated as small or outlier groups.
Neutral labels (Cluster 0–5) are used until descriptive segment names are approved by the business.
